lines.en: I skip along the sunlight.
As I pass, my shadow thins.
Noon is too bright; I duck into the shade.
I circle a patch of light.
I walk a straight line on the roof.
I step through a puddle and the light breaks.
I head off in the sun's direction.
At a quicker pace my light wavers.
I feel my way along the fence.
This road is hot from the sun.
I need some shade to rest in.
Every step I take, I flash.

lines.zh: 我把光折了一下，手没了。
lines.en: I bend the light; my hand vanishes.

lines.zh: 我对着水洼照自己的脸。
lines.en: I check my face in a puddle.
The sun's good; I lie still.
I count how long I can stay lit.
A bird takes me for a sunspot.
I gather light at my fingertip.
Too hot; I hide under a leaf.
I try making my shadow disappear.
The cicadas are giving me a headache.
I cast a bright spot on the wall.
I spot today's first cloud.
A flicker of light makes me laugh.
I close my eyes and still see red.
So bright — anyone could spot me.

lines.zh: 我把手指伸进光里，透明了。
lines.en: I put a finger into the light; it turns clear.

lines.zh: 树影移过来，我就跟着挪。
lines.en: The tree's shadow moves in, so I shift along.
You're standing in my sunshine.
You shine like a plate of brass.
I bet you can't see me.
Your shadow is so long.
I stand on your shoulder watching the view.
Your eyes are narrowing.
I throw light onto your face.
The light changes as you walk over.
Are you here to catch fairies?
There's a bright spot on your hat.

lines.zh: 我晃一下，你能找到我吗。
lines.en: I flicker — can you find me?
Your face is sunburnt red.
I'm behind you; don't turn around.
Don't squint; I'm not that dazzling.

lines.zh: 我的光被打得闪了一下。
lines.en: My light stuttered from the blow.
It hurts; my eyes are swimming.
You hit me — good aim.
I ducked behind the light.
My sleeve is torn.

lines.zh: 我摔在草地上，滚了半圈。
lines.en: I hit the grass and rolled half over.
Stop hitting me; I'm dizzy.

lines.zh: 翅膀缺了一角，阳光补不回来。
lines.en: A corner of my wing is gone; sunlight won't mend it.
I back off two steps to catch my breath.

lines.zh: 我的光被打散了，眼前发白。
lines.en: My light scatters and everything goes white.
Sweet? Even better when sun-warmed.
Hold the candy up to the light.
I smell it — cloyingly sweet.
Half for me and I'll trade you light.

lines.zh: 我嘴上都是糖渣也没关系。
lines.en: It's fine if I get sugar all over my lips.
Don't hide it behind you; I can see.
This one is melting in your hand, isn't it?
I glow when I eat sweets.
Lower your hand a little.
After eating I'll do you a favor.

lines.zh: 我撞在你腿上，弹回去了。
lines.en: I hit your leg and bounced off.

lines.zh: 你那双靴子差点压扁我。
lines.en: Your heavy boot nearly crushed me flat.
Your bump scattered my light.
You're softer than I expected.
Move aside; I'm busy.
You broke my bright spot.
Don't touch me with your hand; it's hot.
We struck off a flash of white.
Back up; I'll walk close beside you.
A bump won't kill you; don't fret.
I'm the noisiest and the quickest to laugh.
Hide from the sun with me.
I'll spin you around; don't let go.
A fairy's affection lasts a day.

lines.zh: 你要是不怕亮，就靠近点。
lines.en: If brightness doesn't scare you, come closer.
Let's lie on the grass and sun our backs.
I don't say things like forever.
Give me a smile and I'll stay.

lines.zh: 明天我还认得你的影子。
lines.en: Tomorrow I'll still know your shadow.
Let's walk this stretch of light together.

lines.zh: 这块玻璃在光下真好看。
lines.en: This glass looks lovely in the light.
I pick it up and hold it to the sun.
If it glitters, I want it.
I slip it up inside my sleeve.
Too heavy; I carry it with light.
I saw it before you; hands off.

lines.zh: 我捡了一堆没用的小东西。
lines.en: I've collected a pile of useless little things.
This coin reflects the most.
I'll carry it home to show the others.
Finding it means I get to show off.

lines.zh: 那边有个东西挡住光了。
lines.en: Something over there is blocking the light.
I'm going to tease it.
It has no light of its own — strange.
I see it, right behind the tree.
This one is big enough to be fun.
It squashed my patch of light.
I'll flash it once to test.
Stand still; I want a closer look.
It's wandering in my direction.
I hide in the light; it can't find me.
This patch is mine to watch over.
I'll make its eyes swim.

lines.zh: 我算准了它眨眼的时候。
lines.en: I've timed exactly when it blinks.
Light gathers hot in my hand.
When it moves, its shadow slides left.
I hug the wall, step by step.
Don't look at me; look elsewhere.
I move the bright spot before its eyes.

lines.zh: 这么近，我看得清它毛孔。
lines.en: This close I can see its pores.
It's beginning to squint.
I'm ready, just waiting for it to turn.
My palm is burning.
Let it move first; I'll follow.
This angle is the most blinding.
Silence is what makes a good trick.
A beam hits it in the eye.
I ram into its lower back.
The flash sends it stumbling backward.
I land another blow.
Hot, isn't it? So am I.
That one is the payback it owed.
It swung and missed; I laughed.
I kick off its shoulder for leverage.
One flash and it reels.
Done, and I hide myself.
The sun rises and I light up.

lines.zh: 我从一片光斑里跳出来。
lines.en: I hop out of a patch of sunlight.
Fine weather again — just my style.
First I check whether the others are around.
The dew dries off at once.
I spread my fingers; light runs between them.
The roof is brightest; I'll start there.
Today I'll make noise until sunset.
I slipped in through the window gap.

lines.zh: 我的光把墙照白了一块。
lines.en: My light whitens a patch of wall.
This bright, I can't hide at all.
I fly half a lap around the yard.
The sun has heated my dress.
Who'll play with me today?
Fire isn't sunlight, and it hurts.
I fell off the roof.
The light in the water goes all wrong.
The blast threw me far away.
An arrow passed straight through my light.
This magic stings more than the sun.

lines.zh: 肚子空着，连影子都变淡了。
lines.en: My belly is empty and even my shadow fades.
Nothing outshines me — do not strike me.

lines.zh: 下面全是黑的，我掉下去。
lines.en: All black below; I'm falling.
